releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.17 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
v1.0.17 Release:
* Top-Left Static Ads Skipping: Guaranteed AD_SCREEN classification precedence over background episode lists, added TOP_LEFT_KEYWORDS_REGEX, and expanded button boundary limit to 360px.
* Sound Toggle Zero-Tolerance Shielding: Full Unicode & Devanagari audio glyph matching, child-node sound indicator inspection, and lowered bare-button confidence.
* Anti-Toggle Repeat-Click Quarantine: Automatically quarantines repeated non-dismissing click targets for 15s to permanently break toggle loops.
* Guarded Fallback Taps: Inhibited blind fallback taps during active video/media playback until 12+ scans of inactivity.
